text.6:76: When the night grew dark upon him he beheld a star. He said: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: I love not things that set.
text.6:77: And when he saw the moon uprising, he exclaimed: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: Unless my Lord guide me, I surely shall become one of the folk who are astray.
text.6:78: And when he saw the sun uprising, he cried: This is my Lord! This is greater! And when it set he exclaimed: O my people! Lo! I am free from all that ye associate (with Him).
